# Zod v4 Source Map

This reference maps the public Zod v4 surface back to the source at `912f0f51b0ced654d0069741e7160834dca742ee`. It is for maintainers and users who want to see where common validators, parse helpers, codecs, JSON Schema helpers, and error formatters live in the repository.

## Zod v4

### Zod v4 Source Map

Path: `/zod-v4/overview.html`

This reference maps the public Zod v4 surface back to the source at `912f0f51b0ced654d0069741e7160834dca742ee`. It is for maintainers and users who want to see where common validators, parse helpers, codecs, JSON Schema helpers, and error formatters live in the repository.

This reference maps the public Zod v4 surface back to the source at 912f0f51b0ced654d0069741e7160834dca742ee . It is for maintainers and users who want to see where common validators, parse helpers, codecs, JSON Schema helpers, and error formatters live in the repository. Target Repository: colinhacks/zod Commit: 912f0f51b0ced654d0069741e7160834dca742ee Package: packages/zod License: MIT, declared in the repository LICENSE and package metadata Public entrypoint: packages/zod/src/index.ts What Is Covered The pages document more than 20 source-backed APIs and concepts: primitive and structural schema constructors string, network, identifier, and binary format helpers synchronous and asynchronous parse helpers encode and decode helpers for codecs wrappers, defaults, transforms, pipes, and custom refinements JSON Schema import/export helpers error tree, flat, formatted, and pretty outputs registry, locale, and configuration exports Source Reading Notes Zod exposes the default v4 classic API through packages/zod/src/index.ts , which re-exports ./v4/classic/external.js . The classic external module then exports schemas , checks , errors , parse , and compatibility helpers, while core internals carry JSON Schema processors and error tree formatters. The most useful source files for this map are: classic/external.ts classic/schemas.ts classic/parse.ts classic/from-json-schema.ts core/json-schema-processors.ts core/errors.ts

### Schema Constructors

Path: `/zod-v4/schema-constructors.html`

Zod's most visible API is the set of schema constructors exposed from `packages/zod/src/v4/classic/schemas.ts`. These functions return concrete schema instances and usually share a nearby `Zod...` constructor implementation.

Zod's most visible API is the set of schema constructors exposed from packages/zod/src/v4/classic/schemas.ts . These functions return concrete schema instances and usually share a nearby Zod... constructor implementation. Primitive Constructors API Source Use z.string() schemas.ts#L567 String schema and the base for string format helpers. z.number() schemas.ts#L1128 Number schema before integer or float width checks. z.int() schemas.ts#L1146 Integer-number format schema. z.boolean() schemas.ts#L1183 Boolean schema. z.bigint() schemas.ts#L1234 BigInt schema. z.symbol() schemas.ts#L1269 Symbol schema. z.any() schemas.ts#L1310 Accepts any input. z.unknown() schemas.ts#L1322 Accepts unknown input while preserving the unknown type. z.never() schemas.ts#L1334 Rejects all inputs. z.date() schemas.ts#L1376 JavaScript Date schema. Structural Constructors API Source Use z.array(element) schemas.ts#L1418 Homogeneous arrays. z.object(shape) schemas.ts#L1572 Object validation with a declared shape. z.strictObject(shape) schemas.ts#L1586 Object validation with strict unknown-key behavior. z.looseObject(shape) schemas.ts#L1600 Object validation with loose unknown-key behavior. z.union(options) schemas.ts#L1626 Try one of several schemas. z.discriminatedUnion(key, options) schemas.ts#L1684 Dispatch object variants by a discriminator key. z.intersection(a, b) schemas.ts#L1716 Combine two compatible schema outputs. z.tuple(items) schemas.ts#L1747 Fixed-position arrays, optionally with a rest schema. z.record(key, value) schemas.ts#L1792 Key-value object records. z.map(key, value) schemas.ts#L1867 JavaScript Map schemas. z.set(value) schemas.ts#L1901 JavaScript Set schemas. z.literal(value) schemas.ts#L2027 Exact literal values. z.nativeEnum(entries) schemas.ts#L1995 Enum-like objects. Less Common Constructors API Source Use z.file() schemas.ts#L2060 File-like values. z.promise(inner) schemas.ts#L2535 Promise outputs. z.lazy(getter) schemas.ts#L2513 Recursive schema graphs. z.function(...) schemas.ts#L2572 Function input and output validation. z.custom(...) schemas.ts#L2632 Custom predicate-backed schemas.

### String And Network Formats

Path: `/zod-v4/string-and-network-formats.html`

String formats are first-class constructors in the classic schema file. The format constructors return specialized string schemas rather than ad hoc refinements, which keeps JSON Schema conversion and error reporting more structured.

String formats are first-class constructors in the classic schema file. The format constructors return specialized string schemas rather than ad hoc refinements, which keeps JSON Schema conversion and error reporting more structured. Identity And URL Formats API Source Notes z.email() schemas.ts#L660 Email address validation. z.guid() schemas.ts#L674 GUID string validation. z.uuid() schemas.ts#L688 UUID validation with version parameters. z.uuidv4() schemas.ts#L692 UUID v4 shortcut. z.uuidv6() schemas.ts#L698 UUID v6 shortcut. z.uuidv7() schemas.ts#L704 UUID v7 shortcut. z.url() schemas.ts#L718 URL parsing and validation. z.httpUrl() schemas.ts#L722 URL validation constrained to HTTP(S)-style use. Identifier Formats API Source Notes z.emoji() schemas.ts#L740 Emoji string format. z.nanoid() schemas.ts#L754 Nano ID validation. z.cuid() schemas.ts#L785 CUID validation. z.cuid2() schemas.ts#L799 CUID2 validation. z.ulid() schemas.ts#L813 ULID validation. z.xid() schemas.ts#L827 XID validation. z.ksuid() schemas.ts#L841 KSUID validation. Network And Binary Formats API Source Notes z.ipv4() schemas.ts#L869 IPv4 address validation. z.ipv6() schemas.ts#L895 IPv6 address validation. z.mac() schemas.ts#L882 MAC address validation. z.cidrv4() schemas.ts#L908 IPv4 CIDR validation. z.cidrv6() schemas.ts#L921 IPv6 CIDR validation. z.base64() schemas.ts#L934 Base64 strings. z.base64url() schemas.ts#L950 URL-safe Base64 strings. z.e164() schemas.ts#L964 E.164 phone number strings. z.jwt() schemas.ts#L978 JWT string validation. z.hostname() schemas.ts#L1005 Hostname format validation. z.hex() schemas.ts#L1009 Hex strings. z.hash() schemas.ts#L1013 Hash strings parameterized by algorithm and encoding.

### Parsing And Codecs

Path: `/zod-v4/parsing-and-codecs.html`

The parse helpers are exported from `classic/parse.ts`, while schema instance methods are installed through `ZodType` in `classic/schemas.ts`. Treat the top-level helpers as convenient functional equivalents when a schema value is already in hand.

The parse helpers are exported from classic/parse.ts , while schema instance methods are installed through ZodType in classic/schemas.ts . Treat the top-level helpers as convenient functional equivalents when a schema value is already in hand. Parse Helpers API Source Result shape parse(schema, data) parse.ts#L8 Throws on invalid input and returns typed output. safeParse(schema, data) parse.ts#L22 Returns success/error result without throwing. parseAsync(schema, data) parse.ts#L15 Promise-returning parse path for async checks. safeParseAsync(schema, data) parse.ts#L29 Promise-returning safe parse path. Encode And Decode Helpers Codecs and transforms can distinguish external input from internal output. The encode/decode helpers expose both directions. API Source Result shape encode(schema, data) parse.ts#L36 Converts output-side data to input-side representation. decode(schema, data) parse.ts#L42 Converts input-side data to output-side representation. safeEncode(schema, data) parse.ts#L60 Non-throwing encode. safeDecode(schema, data) parse.ts#L66 Non-throwing decode. encodeAsync(schema, data) parse.ts#L48 Promise-returning encode. decodeAsync(schema, data) parse.ts#L54 Promise-returning decode. safeEncodeAsync(schema, data) parse.ts#L72 Promise-returning safe encode. safeDecodeAsync(schema, data) parse.ts#L78 Promise-returning safe decode. Codec Constructors API Source Notes z.codec(in, out, handlers) schemas.ts#L2403 Defines paired decode and encode behavior between schemas. z.invertCodec(codec) schemas.ts#L2420 Reverses a codec's direction. z.stringbool() schemas.ts#L2692 Built-in string-to-boolean codec.

### Composition And Transforms

Path: `/zod-v4/composition-and-transforms.html`

Wrappers and composition helpers are concentrated in `classic/schemas.ts`. These APIs let a schema preserve source-level evidence while changing optionality, output shape, defaults, or control flow.

Wrappers and composition helpers are concentrated in classic/schemas.ts . These APIs let a schema preserve source-level evidence while changing optionality, output shape, defaults, or control flow. Wrappers API Source Notes z.optional(inner) schemas.ts#L2140 Accepts undefined in addition to the inner schema. z.exactOptional(inner) schemas.ts#L2165 Exact optional wrapper. z.nullable(inner) schemas.ts#L2190 Accepts null in addition to the inner schema. z.nullish(inner) schemas.ts#L2198 Combines optional and nullable. z.nonoptional(inner) schemas.ts#L2281 Removes optionality from an inner schema. z.readonly(inner) schemas.ts#L2465 Readonly wrapper. Defaults And Fallbacks API Source Notes z.default(inner, value) schemas.ts#L2220 Default value after missing input. z.prefault(inner, value) schemas.ts#L2250 Pre-parse fallback. z.catch(inner, value) schemas.ts#L2323 Fallback on parse failure. z.success(inner) schemas.ts#L2307 Schema that reports parse success as a value. Transformation And Control API Source Notes z.transform(fn) schemas.ts#L2113 Output transform schema. z.pipe(in, out) schemas.ts#L2377 Sequential schema pipeline. z.preprocess(fn, schema) schemas.ts#L2728 Pre-parse transform into another schema. z.check(fn) schemas.ts#L2622 Low-level check function wrapper. z.refine(fn) schemas.ts#L2639 Predicate refinement. z.superRefine(fn) schemas.ts#L2647 Refinement with issue context. z.templateLiteral(parts) schemas.ts#L2487 Template literal schemas. z.json() schemas.ts#L2718 JSON-compatible schema. Instance Methods ZodType installs methods such as .optional() , .nullable() , .array() , .or() , .and() , .transform() , .pipe() , .readonly() , .describe() , and .meta() on schema instances. The source comment explains that these methods are lazily bound and cached per instance to keep detached usage working. Method declarations: schemas.ts#L72-L176 Lazy install mechanism: schemas.ts#L16-L57

### JSON Schema And Errors

Path: `/zod-v4/json-schema-and-errors.html`

Zod v4 exports JSON Schema conversion and several error projections through the classic external entrypoint. These are useful when Zod sits between runtime validation, documentation, and API contracts.

Zod v4 exports JSON Schema conversion and several error projections through the classic external entrypoint. These are useful when Zod sits between runtime validation, documentation, and API contracts. JSON Schema API Source Notes z.toJSONSchema(schema) json-schema-processors.ts#L613 Converts a Zod schema to JSON Schema using type-specific processors. z.fromJSONSchema(schema) from-json-schema.ts#L629 Builds a Zod schema from JSON Schema input. stringProcessor json-schema-processors.ts#L27 String JSON Schema processor. arrayProcessor json-schema-processors.ts#L276 Array JSON Schema processor. objectProcessor json-schema-processors.ts#L290 Object JSON Schema processor. unionProcessor json-schema-processors.ts#L336 Union JSON Schema processor. recordProcessor json-schema-processors.ts#L428 Record JSON Schema processor. optionalProcessor json-schema-processors.ts#L553 Optional wrapper processor. Error Views API Source Notes flattenError(error) errors.ts#L263 Groups field errors and form errors. formatError(error) errors.ts#L291 Creates nested formatted error output. treeifyError(error) errors.ts#L345 Builds a tree-shaped error structure. prettifyError(error) errors.ts#L442 Renders a readable string summary of issues. ZodError classic/errors.ts#L64 Classic error constructor export. setErrorMap(map) compat.ts#L46 Compatibility API for setting global error mapping. getErrorMap() compat.ts#L53 Reads the active error map. Registry And Configuration The external module exports registry/configuration utilities from core: globalRegistry , registry , config , $output , $input , $brand , clone , regexes , TimePrecision , util , and NEVER are exported through classic/external.ts#L13-L30 . Locale exports are available from classic/external.ts#L36-L37 .
